newsitem.title: UK: MRS LOGISTICA SETS TWO BONDS WORTH TOTAL $320 MLN.
newsitem.headline: MRS LOGISTICA SETS TWO BONDS WORTH TOTAL $320 MLN.

text.p: LONDON, Aug 7 (Reuter) The MRS Logistica consortium, led by Brazilian steel firm CSN, has launched two structured eight-year bonds worth a total $320 million, lead manager Bankers Trust international said on Thursday.
A $125 million tranche has call and put options after three years and will be priced to yield 305 basis points over the three-year U.S. Treasury note.
A $195 million tranche is callable after five years and will be priced to yield 450 b.p. over the 6.50 percent U.S. Treasury note due 2005.
MRS Logistica, rated BB-/B, also includes steel firm Cosigua, mining companies MBR and Ferteco, fertilizer firm Ultrafertil, transport groups Celato and Interferrea and two pension funds.
Last September, the consortium acquired a 30-year concession to operate the southeast section of Brazil's federal railway network.
